en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from a slightly elevated vantage point. In the foreground are cultivated fields or gardens with laundry hanging to dry and several people working. Beyond this, dense rows of tiled‑roof houses fill the middle ground. Two prominent church towers rise above the buildings: on the right, a Baroque onion‑dome tower with a weather vane; on the left, a tall Gothic spire from a large church on a hill. The background shows more scattered buildings and flat farmland stretching to the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
